entries.title: Luke 21:1
segments:
:4
 
Casting their gifts into the treasury. The treasury of the Temple was in the Court of the Women, but the name 'treasury' was also applied to the colonnade around this court, in which were placed contribution boxed shaped like trumpets.  According to the text it would seem that the widow who cast two mites into the treasury did so in one of these boxes, along with the rich men who were contributing.  See notes on

There shall not be left here one stone upon another. The fall of Jerusalem and the Second Coming of Christ are predicted in these verses.
 

 
For a testimony. For an opportunity to bear witness and suffer for the truth's sake.
 

 
Mouth. Words.
 

 
Compassed with armies. The Roman legions.
